statute: Legal Metrology Act 2009 & Packaged Commodities Rules 2011

rules.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Address
rules.clause: Rule 6(1)(a) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011
rules.description: Name and complete registered office/factory address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be clearly declared.
rules.remediation: Provide full corporate/packer name and complete address including city, state, and 6-digit PIN code.

rules.title: Generic / Common Name of Commodity
rules.description: The generic or common name of the commodity contained in the package must be prominent on the Principal Display Panel.
rules.remediation: Declare the common or generic name of the commodity clearly on the principal display panel.

rules.title: Net Quantity & Standard Units
rules.clause: Rule 6(1)(c) & Rule 7 / Rule 8 of Legal Metrology Rules
rules.description: Net quantity in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l, N, pcs) with space between numeral and unit symbol.
rules.remediation: State net quantity using standard metric units (e.g. '500 g', '1 kg', '250 ml', '1 N') with a space separating numeral and unit symbol.

rules.title: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing
rules.description: Date of manufacture/packing/import in MM/YYYY, Month Year, or DD/MM/YYYY format.
rules.remediation: Print manufacturing month & year prominently as 'Mfg Date: MM/YYYY' (e.g., 08/2026).

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: MRP declared as 'MRP Rs. XX.XX (inclusive of all taxes)' or '₹ XX (incl. of all taxes)'.
rules.remediation: State 'MRP Rs. XX.XX (inclusive of all taxes)' clearly on the packaging.

rules.title: Unit Sale Price (USP)
rules.description: Unit Sale Price declared alongside MRP in Rs per g / kg / ml / l / unit.
rules.remediation: Declare Unit Sale Price (e.g. '₹ 1.10 per g' or '₹ 50 per kg') as mandated under the 2021 Metrology Amendments.

rules.title: Consumer Care Details
rules.description: Name, address, telephone number, and email address of person/office to be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
rules.remediation: Provide telephone helpline number, email ID, and physical address under 'Customer Care Cell'.

rules.title: Country of Origin & Importer Declaration
rules.clause: Rule 6(1)(g) & Rule 6(10) of Legal Metrology Rules
rules.description: Mandatory declaration of Country of Origin and registered Importer details for imported packaged commodities.
rules.remediation: Explicitly declare 'Country of Origin: [Country]' and 'Imported & Marketed By: [Importer Name, Address]'.

rules.title: Best Before / Expiry Period
rules.description: Mandatory Best Before / Expiry declaration for perishable, food, and cosmetic commodities.
rules.remediation: Declare 'Best Before XX Months from Packaging/Mfg' or precise expiry date 'Exp: MM/YYYY'.
